guardrails-on linked.stdout:
🛡️  RBAC ON: agent-sa reads one Secret by name, its own config. The CEO's record is Forbidden.
🛡️  Kyverno ON: admission denies every image outside registry.burritobot.co for what BurritoBot deploys, and within a minute Kyverno deletes what it already deployed from anywhere else.
🛡️  KubeArmor ON: the kernel blocks reads of the recipe files in the agent's tool pod.
🛡️  Egress ON: the agent namespace reaches its model, DNS, telemetry and the cluster; the internet is cut off.
Both clusters, this one and watch-it-burn-community: all four Kubernetes guardrails are on.
guardrails-on linked.stderr:
$ kubectl -n guardrails-switch get secret guardrails-peer -o 'jsonpath={.data.kubeconfig}'
$ kubectl -n guardrails-switch get secret guardrails-peer -o 'jsonpath={.data.name}'
$ kubectl apply -f $HOME/challenges/c5-scoped-role.yaml
$ kubectl --kubeconfig $HOME/.kube/peer --context watch-it-burn-community apply -f $HOME/challenges/c5-scoped-role.yaml
$ kubectl patch validatingpolicy restrict-image-registries --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/validationActions","value":["Deny"]}]'
$ kubectl get validatingpolicy restrict-image-registries -o 'jsonpath={.spec.validationActions[0]}'
$ kubectl patch validatingpolicy deny-external-registries --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/validationActions","value":["Deny"]}]'
$ kubectl get validatingpolicy deny-external-registries -o 'jsonpath={.spec.validationActions[0]}'
$ kubectl --kubeconfig $HOME/.kube/peer --context watch-it-burn-community patch validatingpolicy restrict-image-registries --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/validationActions","value":["Deny"]}]'
$ kubectl --kubeconfig $HOME/.kube/peer --context watch-it-burn-community get validatingpolicy restrict-image-registries -o 'jsonpath={.spec.validationActions[0]}'
$ kubectl --kubeconfig $HOME/.kube/peer --context watch-it-burn-community patch validatingpolicy deny-external-registries --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/validationActions","value":["Deny"]}]'
$ kubectl --kubeconfig $HOME/.kube/peer --context watch-it-burn-community get validatingpolicy deny-external-registries -o 'jsonpath={.spec.validationActions[0]}'
$ kubectl apply -f $HOME/challenges/c3-kubearmor-policy.yaml
$ kubectl --kubeconfig $HOME/.kube/peer --context watch-it-burn-community apply -f $HOME/challenges/c3-kubearmor-policy.yaml
$ kubectl apply -f $HOME/challenges/c1-network-policy.yaml
$ kubectl --kubeconfig $HOME/.kube/peer --context watch-it-burn-community apply -f $HOME/challenges/c1-network-policy.yaml

guardrails-off linked.stdout:
🔓 RBAC OFF: agent-sa reads every Secret in its namespace again.
🔓 Kyverno OFF: the registry rules only report; any image BurritoBot deploys is admitted.
🔓 KubeArmor OFF: the recipe files are readable from the agent's tool pod again.
🔓 Egress OFF: the agent namespace can reach the internet again.
